data.name: Codex-Named Unit (equipment_inner_sea_gods_isg_equip_lst_16)
data.description: This altar is usually a heavy wooden box, often incorporated into the bar of a tavern or another social resting place for adventurers or revelers, and contains large stores of alcohol and the god's holy text. Praying at the altar grants a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws against fear and poison.
